# Town of Craftsbury municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 6; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Craftsbury official website, Selectboard page: lists Bruce Urie (Co-Chair), Jim Jones (Co-Chair), and Alison Blaney, all elected to 3-year terms.

Town of Craftsbury, 2025 Annual Town Report, '2025 Craftsbury Elected Positions' roster (craftsbury.gov): lists 'SELECT BOARD (3 year term): James Jones (2026), Alison Blaney (2027), Bruce Urie (2028)'; the town's Certification of Votes for March 3, 2026 records James Jones re-elected to the 3-year seat (114 votes). The Secretary of State directory publishes no Craftsbury roster.

Town of Craftsbury, 2025 Annual Town Report, '2025 Craftsbury Elected Positions' roster (craftsbury.gov): lists 'TOWN CLERK & TREASURER (3 year term): Michelle Warren (2028)' -- the clerk and treasurer are elected as combined offices.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Michelle Warren as Town Clerk of Craftsbury.

Town of Craftsbury, 2025 Annual Town Report, '2025 Craftsbury Elected Positions' roster (craftsbury.gov): lists 'TOWN CLERK & TREASURER (3 year term): Michelle Warren (2028)' -- the clerk and treasurer are elected as combined offices.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Michelle Warren as Town Treasurer of Craftsbury.
Town of Craftsbury, 2025 Annual Town Report, '2025 Craftsbury Elected Positions' roster (craftsbury.gov): lists 'MODERATOR (1 year term): Jeannine Young (2026)'.

Town of Craftsbury official website, Elected and Appointed Officers page, lists Jeannine Young as Moderator; the official Town Meeting Minutes of March 3, 2026 record her election as Moderator for 2026.
Town of Craftsbury official website, Listers page: lists three elected Listers on 3-year terms: Harry Miller, Jeremiah McCann, and Tom Boyle.
Town of Craftsbury, 2025 Annual Town Report, '2025 Craftsbury Elected Positions' roster (craftsbury.gov): lists 'LISTER (3 year term): Tom Boyle (2026), Harry Miller (2027), Jeremiah McCann (2028)'.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Craftsbury justices of the peace: Yvette Brown, Timothy Fritz, Harry H. Miller, David Rowell, and Allison Van Akkeren.
